description: This file defines an abstract class 'SerializingCustomDatatype' in the package 'org.openmrs.customdatatype'. It implements the 'CustomDatatype' interface and provides default implementations for serialization, deserialization, validation, and other operations for custom data types in OpenMRS, allowing subclasses to specify serialization logic.

classes.name: SerializingCustomDatatype
classes.description: An abstract class providing a template for serializing and deserializing custom data types within OpenMRS, including default validation and summary generation logic.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a typed value into its String representation.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Abstract method to reconstruct a typed value from its String representation.

methods.name: doGetTextSummary
methods.description: Generates a plain-text summary of the typed value, defaulting to its toString() representation.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Default implementation; does nothing. Subclasses may override to handle configuration.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the typed value, ensuring it is not null and complies with any OpenmrsObject constraints.

methods.name: fromReferenceString
methods.description: Converts a reference string into a typed value by deserializing it.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates the typed value and serializes it for storage.

methods.name: getReferenceStringForValue
methods.description: Serializes a typed value into its reference string.

methods.name: getTextSummary
methods.description: Provides a textual summary of the value given its reference string, using deserialization.
